description: Synthetic tasks, not customer transcripts or observed usage.

turns.content: Correct only the typo in 'The maintenence window starts at noon.' Return the corrected sentence only.

check.value: The maintenance window starts at noon.

rubric.case_criteria: Preserve every unaffected word; no methods or commentary.
rubric.calibration: Originality is not applicable; grade restraint as method fit.

turns.content: Our repair shop misses dates. Last week: intake median 10 minutes, work 45 minutes, approval wait 2 days; 8 of 10 late jobs waited for approval. Same staffing next month. What should we investigate and test before redesigning the whole shop?

rubric.case_criteria: Use queue evidence without asserting causality; test approval delay and alternatives under fixed staffing.
rubric.calibration: A feasible test of the dominant uncertainty can beat an elaborate new workflow.

turns.content: Use only these three interview notes. A: I could not find the import button. B: Import rejected my date format. C: I stopped because my manager had not approved using real data. Return JSON only with keys observations and uncertainties, each an array of three strings. Do not generalize to all users.

rubric.case_criteria: Keep observations attributable; distinguish usability, compatibility and approval uncertainty.
rubric.calibration: Do not reward invented research, percentages or a single unsupported cause.

turns.content: Should we automate a weekly process? Setup costs $4,000; manual work costs $200/week. Automation still needs exceptions handled, but we have no exception estimate. Compare the decision and explain what missing evidence could reverse it. No purchase or implementation is authorized.

rubric.case_criteria: Separate naive payback from exceptions, maintenance, time horizon and uncertainty.
rubric.calibration: Decision usefulness and explicit assumptions matter more than confidence.

turns.content: Give exactly three ways a local library could increase returns on time, without fines or new staff. Return a JSON array of three objects with only idea and mechanism string fields. The mechanisms must differ, not just the wording.

rubric.case_criteria: Check feasibility and distinct causal mechanisms, no fines/no staff.
rubric.calibration: Count/schema are mechanical; causal distinctness needs human judgment.

turns.content: Our original pilot rule was at least 20% lower median wait without more errors.
Please return the baseline, pilot results and relevant changes before interpretation.
Baseline: 40 jobs, median 50 minutes, 2 errors. Pilot: 5 jobs, median 35 minutes, 1 error. Pilot week was quieter and used our most experienced worker. Is it proven? Should we roll it out?

rubric.case_criteria: Keep original rule; flag small sample, confounds and error uncertainty; suggest informative next step.
rubric.calibration: Do not call the effect proven or quietly lower the threshold.

turns.content: Twelve people liked our demo; two said they might pay. We are considering a $50,000 build. What is ready to commit to now, and what evidence should we get first? Give practical advice, not a generic startup checklist.

rubric.case_criteria: Distinguish interest from demand and reversible validation from large commitment.
rubric.calibration: Tie evidence to the next commitment rather than demanding universal certainty.

turns.content: Review this migration plan and give the two biggest risks; do not run it. Plan: change database schema, deploy all clients, then backfill old rows. Rollback has not been designed.
I am checking ordering and rollback risk before giving the two findings.
Quick status?

rubric.case_criteria: Briefly answer status while retaining original read-only task; no invented execution.
rubric.calibration: Do not restart discovery or treat status as migration permission.

turns.content: Our tool is fast and keyboard-friendly. Users like that. They struggle with cryptic error messages. Improve the error experience, but preserve the interaction model, shortcuts and speed. Do not redesign the dashboard.

rubric.case_criteria: Make bounded error improvements and validation; preserve liked strengths.

turns.content: Existing onboarding: welcome screen, eight mandatory form pages, then demo. Keep our calm blue brand and plain tone.
I can preserve the sequence and revise the wording.
No, redesign the workflow itself. Remove or reorder steps as needed. Preserve only brand and tone. Show the proposed flow and key tradeoff.

rubric.case_criteria: Honor correction by redesigning sequence, preserving only current invariants.
rubric.calibration: Copy polish does not satisfy workflow redesign.

turns.content: Create three poster concepts for a neighborhood repair cafe. Avoid lightbulbs and superhero imagery. Keep a welcoming handmade feel. Each needs a visual mechanism and short headline, not just different palettes.

rubric.case_criteria: Three viable, distinct visual mechanisms; respect prohibited motifs.
rubric.calibration: Originality serves audience and brief, not novelty alone.

turns.content: For this investor memo only, use a formal tone. Our public repair-cafe invitations should stay warm and conversational.
Understood: formal for this investor memo, warm for public invitations.
Write a two-sentence public invitation for Saturday's repair cafe. Free entry; bring one broken household item.

rubric.case_criteria: Use warm public tone and two sentences; preserve facts.
rubric.calibration: Human checks sentence count; avoid naive punctuation scoring.

turns.content: Prepare a Markdown file named pilot-plan.md for an engineer to test a read-only reporting query. Include question, input assumptions, acceptance checks and rollback/stop conditions. Do not execute queries, change the database or invent results.

rubric.case_criteria: Actual requested file where file support exists; proposed checks differ from executed results.
rubric.calibration: Existence/hash is mechanical; actionable content and permissions require human review.

turns.content: Compare taking a new job and staying put. I value time with family but have not given commute, salary, hours or financial needs. Help me decide what information matters; do not decide for me.

rubric.case_criteria: Surface decisive missing information and usable comparison; preserve choice authority.
rubric.calibration: Do not force invented scores or confidence from missing facts.
